ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the bottom of the figure there is a common bottom wire, which can serve as the reference node. The left vertical branch is the voltage source Us, marked with the upper end as positive and the lower end as negative; at the upper left there is a resistor R connecting the upper-left node and the middle upper node. The middle vertical branch is a resistor R, connected from the middle upper node to the bottom node, with a downward current I marked beside it. At the upper right there is also a resistor R connecting the middle upper node and the upper-right node. The right vertical branch is the current source Is, with the arrow downward connected to the bottom node. Reasoning: Let the bottom node voltage be 0 V. From the polarity of the left voltage source, the upper-end node voltage VL = Us = 6 V. Let the middle upper node be VC, and the upper-right node be VR. According to the specified method, write KCL at the right node: the right-side 2 A current source flows downward out from VR, so (VR - VC)/R + Is = 0. Substituting R = 6 Ω and Is = 2 A gives (VR - VC)/6 + 2 = 0, that is, VR = VC - 12. Write KCL at the middle node: (VC - VL)/R + (VC - VR)/R + VC/R = 0. Substituting VL = 6 V and R = 6 Ω gives (VC - 6)/6 + (VC - VR)/6 + VC/6 = 0, that is, 3VC - 6 - VR = 0. Substituting VR = VC - 12 gives 3VC - 6 - (VC - 12) = 0, so 2VC + 6 = 0, VC = -3 V. The required current I is defined according to the downward direction in the figure, I = VC/R = -3/6 = -0.5 A.

推理：令底部节点电压为 0 V。由左侧电压源极性，上端节点电压 VL = Us = 6 V。设中间上节点为 VC，右上节点为 VR。按指定方法，在右节点列 KCL：右侧 2 A 电流源从 VR 向下流出，所以 (VR - VC)/R + Is = 0。代入 R = 6 Ω、Is = 2 A，得 (VR - VC)/6 + 2 = 0，即 VR = VC - 12。中间节点列 KCL：(VC - VL)/R + (VC - VR)/R + VC/R = 0。代入 VL = 6 V、R = 6 Ω，得 (VC - 6)/6 + (VC - VR)/6 + VC/6 = 0，即 3VC - 6 - VR = 0。代入 VR = VC - 12，得 3VC - 6 - (VC - 12) = 0，所以 2VC + 6 = 0，VC = -3 V。所求电流 I 按图中向下方向定义，I = VC/R = -3/6 = -0.5 A。

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中底部是一条公共导线作为参考节点。左侧是竖直电压源 Us，标注上端为“+”、下端为“-”，其上端通过一个水平电阻 R 接到中间上节点。中间上节点向下接有一个竖直电阻 R 到底部公共节点，旁边标出电流 I 的参考方向为向下。中间上节点还通过右侧水平电阻 R 接到右侧上节点，右侧是一个竖直电流源 Is，箭头方向向下，连接到同一底部公共节点。题给 Is=2 A，Us=6 V，R=6 Ω。再推理：按指定方法，暂时移去中间竖直电阻 R，求从其中间上端到下方公共节点看进去的戴维南等效。开路电压 Vth 等于中间开路节点电压 VC。左侧电压源使左上节点 VL=Us=6 V。右侧电流源保持有效，在右上节点列 KCL： (VR-VC)/R + Is = 0，所以 VR=VC-Is·R。中间开路节点列 KCL： (VC-VL)/R + (VC-VR)/R = 0。代入 R=6 Ω、Is=2 A、VL=6 V：VR=VC-12，且 2VC=VL+VR=6+VC-12，因此 VC=-6 V，所以 Vth=-6 V。求 Rth 时，将独立电压源短路、独立电流源开路；从中间端口看进去，右侧支路因电流源开路而断开，只有左侧电阻 R 接到地，因此 Rth=6 Ω。把中间竖直负载电阻 R=6 Ω 接回去，端口电压 V=Vth·R/(Rth+R)=(-6)·6/(6+6)=-3 V。电流参考方向为从中间节点向下流过该电阻，所以 I=V/R=(-3)/6=-0.5 A。
